scholarly_quality.concise_summary: ProtLingo augments a pretrained ESM2-150M backbone with centered latent N-gram memory and sparse MoE upcycling. The paper reports competitive ProteinGym, FLIP, and CASP15 contact prediction results with 153M active parameters, supported by ablations and biological specialization analyses. The available text is partial but contains substantive implementation, evaluation, and limitation details.
